notes.title: Touhou Koi-Mystrey DEMO version Release and content description
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768177/bba23c288769827ace273adcfd0340b0864a084e.jpg
Many friends have been waiting for the official version of the game~

Please don't be impatient, because good things take a lot of time. The official version of "Touhou Koi-Mystrey" is already in an orderly progress~

But in order to soothe your anxious hearts in the hot summer, We hereby announce:
"Touhou Koi-Mystrey" Now launch a playable trial version in Steam !
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1664510

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768177/26c26beb34f12db33a7d4fb223086ce8d22951a1.png
Just click "download trial" at the bottom right of the store page to play for free!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609270/

This version contains 2.5 chapters in total, and there is still one chapter boss war, which is only three chapters. About the first third of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768177/0118d36e63773df18ea175c77adae079142a0773.jpg
>At the suggestion of the players of the internal beta version, we provide better full screen mode and optional resolution settings, which can let the computer that could not run the game see the beauty of Koishi!

>Optimized the display of English and Japanese text and fixed serious typesetting problems

>Provides tips and setting item localization in English and Japanese

>At present, the plot localization of English and Japanese texts is machine translation, and some pages have not been localized

Due to a large number of additions and changes in the game text, large-scale professional localization has not been carried out at present. Please forgive me.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768177/b4163d87bc150e534a8e3df3de13e71a9f593041.jpg
In addition, the game will participate in the steam new product festival in October 2021. 
At that time, developers will play and communicate with the majority of players about this game. 

We welcome everyone to actively feedback on this game! Tell us through various channels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768177/87748370c5fe8b415bdd3555d780aa7f73ddd08e.jpg
Thank you very much for the support and encouragement of the majority of players who like this game or have played this game. We will do better and better. 

In 2022, we will bring this work with 7 chapters and hundreds of CG to give back to you. 
We'll see you all~
